evidence.name: Screen field: Purchase button text weight
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Purchase button text weight" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Purchase button text weight
sections.description: Controls how thick or bold the button label appears, on a scale from 400 (regular) to 700 (bold) and heavier. As your primary call-to-action it should look bold and confident — a weight of 600 to 700 helps it visually dominate any secondary buttons on the screen.
